description: This Java source file defines the MainTweaksFragment class, which is a fragment used in the settings UI of the AnySoftKeyboard app. It manages preferences related to developer tools and tweaks, including loading preferences from XML, handling preference clicks, and setting the activity title.

classes.name: MainTweaksFragment
classes.description: A fragment that manages the main tweaks and developer tools preferences in the app's settings.

methods.name: onCreatePreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from the specified XML resource.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the preference click listener for the developer tools preference.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity title to the tweaks group string.

methods.name: onDevToolsPreferenceClicked
methods.description: Handles the click event for the developer tools preference, navigating to the developer tools fragment.
